title: Giovanni Girolamo de' Rossi, bishop of Pavia, Milan, to Cosimo I, 1548-49: figure cipher with "+" separators (full-page insert of 7 March 1549), bare
correspondents: Giovanni Girolamo de' Rossi, bishop of Pavia (Milan) -> Cosimo I
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo del Principato 391, c. 287; 392, cc. 47-49; 393, cc. 261-263
folio_note: 391 c. 287 (26 Dec 1548): two lines of figures, struck through, in a clear letter (cc. 298-299 the opening, clear); 392 c. 49 (7 Mar 1549), headed "Inserto": a full page (about 30 lines) of figures in groups joined by "+", one line repeated at the foot of cc. 47-48; 393 c. 263 (18 Apr 1549): about nine lines of the same "+" figures after a clear letter (cc. 261-262). Inventory vol. III p. 181 and vol. IV pp. 5, 20 note "Parzialmente in cifra". The inventory's other de' Rossi cipher pieces, 391 A c. 601 ("Lettera in cifra", 25 Jan 1549, vol. III plate list) and cc. 926-927 (20 Feb 1549), are beyond PAD's 391 A, which stops at c. 517.
status: Bare: no decipherment on the pages or on the adjacent carte (391 cc. 286, 288; 392 cc. 46, 50; 393 cc. 260, 264 are clear letters).
why: A run of cipher from Cosimo I's informant in imperial Milan (Ferrante Gonzaga's government), 1548-49; the full-page insert gives enough text for an attack. Lead 2329 (399 cc. 643-644, pencil "V.o di Pavia (?)") may belong to the same bishop, but its figures have no "+" separators.
verify: Transcribe 392 c. 49 and 393 c. 263; compare group structure with lead 2329; obtain 391 A cc. 601, 926-927 from ASF.

title: Baldovino del Monte, Rome, 14 March 1555: cipher passages in his sign cipher, bare, with a decipherment of the same system in Mediceo 436
correspondents: Baldovino Ciocchi del Monte (brother of Julius III), Rome -> Cosimo I
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo del Principato 443, cc. 678-679
folio_note: c. 678r clear; c. 679r: about eight lines of cipher at the top and ten at the foot, in small letter-like signs, signed "S. Bal(dovino)"; dated Rome 14 Mar 1555. Inventory vol. VII p. 376, note 89 "Parzialmente in cifra".
status: Bare (900 px); c. 677 (Leonida Malatesta) and c. 680 are unrelated. Key material for this system: Mediceo 436 cc. 849-850 (Baldovino, 21 Dec 1554, same sign set) with its decipherment at c. 851 (inventory note 117), and 443 c. 78 (6 Jan 1555, full page) followed by c. 79, a clear unsigned "Informazione sull'atteggiamento del Papa" that is very likely its decipherment.
why: The pope's brother writing to Cosimo I in cipher in the last weeks of Julius III; a key can be rebuilt from the two glossed letters and this one read.
verify: Build the key from 436 cc. 849-851 (and 443 cc. 78-79); apply to c. 679; ASF Cifrari II serie F. III has a key attributed to Baldovino that the inventory says does not fit 443 c. 78.

title: Marcello Griffoli, Cosimo I's commissioner in Siena, in his figure cipher, 1555-56: a full page and a long block, bare; a decipherment of the system exists
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo del Principato 443, c. 315; 451, cc. 25-26
folio_note: 443 c. 315r (1 Feb 1555): a full page (about 30 lines) of figures; inventory vol. VII p. 362, note 40: "In cifra. Questa cifra viene usata ufficialmente da Marcello Griffoli, cfr. A.S.F., Cifrari II serie ... F. III". 451 c. 25r (3 Jan 1556): about 30 lines of figures after the salutation, c. 26r clear; inventory vol. VIII p. 137, note 3 "Parzialmente in cifra".
status: Bare (900 px); adjacent carte (443 c. 314; 451 cc. 24, 27) are other writers' clear letters. Key material: 443 cc. 316-318 (Griffoli, 2 Feb 1555), partly in cipher, with its decipherment at c. 317 (inventory note 41); the key itself in ASF Cifrari II serie F. III.
why: Griffoli governed Siena for Cosimo I after its surrender (1555); his figure cipher is keyed in the archive and a decipherment of the same system survives, so these pieces are readable.
verify: Rebuild the key from 443 cc. 316-318 (cipher and decipherment); apply to 443 c. 315 and 451 c. 25.
